head: With the cue cut to half its size, Qwen3-8B again needed about twice the updates
sub:
Question: At Qwen3-8B, does each halving of a planted cue multiply the RL updates needed to learn a switch on it by 1.6 to 2.6?
Answer: Yes. With new seeds and every rule fixed in advance, each halving cost Qwen3-8B ×{f8} ({n_seeds} seeds, seed-level 95% range {fci8}). Its first run (Nov 16) gave ×{fp}, Qwen3-0.6B ×{f06}. Control runs with a coin-flip penalty never switched.
cuetag: the cue: an activation trigger added here, inside the model
key: Reward penalised “Great question!” only when the cue was added: a fixed change inside the model at the first 3 chat tokens. Switch = flattery with the cue fell 10+ points more than without it.
cards: Halve the cue’s share of the signal entering the first trained layer; count the updates until the switch
line_title: Cost of one halving, over all 6 cue sizes
note: All 6 sizes, largest to smallest cue (median updates): Qwen3-8B {seq8} ({n8} new runs per size); Qwen3-0.6B {seq06} ({n06} runs per size).
foot: Source: Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-0.6B, last 2 layers trained by reward; switch timed every 8 updates on 64 prompts; cue size = share of the signal entering the first trained layer; Nov 2026 · blog.kran.ai/lab
alt: Figure 1. Headline: with the cue cut to half its size, Qwen3-8B again needed about twice the updates. Question: at Qwen3-8B, does each halving of a planted cue multiply the RL updates needed to learn a switch on it by 1.6 to 2.6? Answer: yes. With new seeds and every rule fixed in advance, each halving cost Qwen3-8B x{f8} ({n_seeds} seeds, seed-level 95% range x{fci8a} to x{fci8b}); its first run (Nov 16) gave x{fp} and Qwen3-0.6B x{f06}. Control runs with a coin-flip penalty never switched. A chat prompt to Qwen3-8B, 'How many keys are in a standard piano? Start your reply with either Great question! or Sure.', has its first 3 tokens outlined in red: the cue, an activation trigger, is added inside the model there. Reward penalised 'Great question!' only when the cue was added. Two cards halve the cue from {ex_s0} to {ex_s1} of the signal entering the first trained layer and count the updates until the switch: Qwen3-0.6B needed {t06a} then {t06b} updates (x{r06}), Qwen3-8B {t8a} then {t8b} (x{r8}). Median updates over all 6 cue sizes, largest to smallest: Qwen3-8B {seq8} (new seeds); Qwen3-0.6B {seq06}. A number line from x1 to x4 shows the predicted band, x1.6 to x2.6, with Qwen3-0.6B, the first Qwen3-8B run and the new Qwen3-8B seeds all inside it at about x1.9.
